notes:
- Company: Sparrow CI Copilots — developer tooling startup building an IDE-first copilot that executes small test runs, linters and builds via tool/function-calls inside a sandboxed environment.
- Primary ask: function-calling API that can invoke short-lived test runners and linter processes with strict sandboxing (no network, ephemeral FS). Need low-latency streaming for token-by-token completion inside IDE (sub-100ms goal for first byte).
- Model/versioning: per-workspace model pinning, ability to route to quantized fallback for non-critical completions; need reproducible versioning for audit.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS for artifacts, retain audit logs for 12+ months, data residency in US/EU. Air-gapped proof-of-concept for on-prem customers later.
- POC plan: Redwood SE to implement function-call wiring that launches a Firecracker micro-VM or container with strict seccomp policies; run sample test matrix (unit + quick integration) and stream build logs back to IDE; measure p95 latency and cost per run.
- Quote from CTO: "We cannot allow agents to reach the network or exfiltrate secrets — strict sandbox + ephemeral artifacts are non-negotiable."
- Performance goals: 1) first-token latency <100ms for completions, 2) end-to-end test-run turnaround <2s for unit tests (where feasible), 3) scalable routing to cheaper models for non-blocking suggestions.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — startup but willing to commit to Dedicated if predictability and guarantees met. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching/lowering per-test cost.
- Legal/procurement: procurement wants a 12-month committed Dedicated option; legal requested SOC2/ISO references and a list of data flows.
- Quick wins: demo showed function-calling can return structured test results; need SE to implement sandbox snapshotting and artifact TTL to satisfy security.
- Next meeting: 2026-03-12 POC kickoff (SE, AE, CTO, security engineer).
short_description: Evaluation of Redwood for an IDE copilot that uses function-calling to run sandboxed tests, linters and stream build logs back to the editor. Focus on model pinning, low-latency streaming, and strict isolation.
decision_criteria: security isolation, first-byte latency, model/version pinning, predictable cost for per-test execution, auditability of runs
customer_quote: "We need deterministic sandboxing for code agents — if Redwood can guarantee no exfiltration and low latency, we can commit to Dedicated."
